title: Shop Thermostat
description: The purpose of this RenderWeekly project was to find a rugged thermostat form that could be used in a shop environment as an assistant, and could be easily read and adjusted from across the room.

brief.label: Brief
brief.text: A RenderWeekly project: a rugged thermostat for a shop that also acts as an assistant.

brief.label: Users
brief.text: People working in a shop or garage who need to read and adjust the temperature from across the room.

brief.label: Design response
brief.text: Large numerals and a big dial in a rugged housing, mounted to the shop wall.

brief.label: Competition
brief.text: Smart thermostats from HVAC makers such as Carrier, Johnson Controls and Trane, and consumer brands like Google Nest and ecobee.
